speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to the clinic. I see you have a painful, ulcerative skin lesion on your leg; please describe exactly where it is located and how long it has been there. Additionally, have you noticed any fever, chills, or recent insect bites in that area?

speaker: Patient
text: 54-year-old woman. The patient reports a skin lesion on her right leg that has been present for 1 month. The lesion began as a small red spot and has increased in size. She recalls an ant bite at the site before the lesion developed. She has a history of anterior uveitis treated with corticosteroids 8 months ago, as well as Crohn's disease, type 2 diabetes mellitus, and hypertension.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Cutaneous Leishmaniasis (or possibly Pyoderma Gangrenosum). I am ready to make a diagnosis based on the clinical evidence provided.
